about_the_game:
💣 Bomberrage – Explosive Multiplayer Battles!

Overview: Step into the chaos of Bomberrage, a fast-paced, action-packed multiplayer game where strategy and reflexes decide who survives! Battle against smart AI or challenge friends in explosive skirmishes, where every second counts!

Key Features:

🔥 Intense Multiplayer Battles – Face off against AI or real players in dynamic bomb fights!
🧠 Challenging AI Opponents – Adapt and outsmart relentless enemies!
🗺 Ever-Changing Arenas – Procedurally generated maps keep battles fresh!
🎮 Easy to Pick Up, Hard to Master – Fun for casual players, rewarding for competitive ones!
🎬 Epic Cinematics & Unique Characters – Explosions have never looked this good!

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2500K / AMD FX-6300
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 (2GB) / AMD Radeon RX 560
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 6 GB available space

Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-8700K / AMD Ryzen 7 2700X
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2060 / AMD RX 5700 XT
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
